concepts.description: Illustrative bright manufacturing-management desk with a neutral chip sample and blank paper dossier. No customer facility, software UI, actual product or equipment evidence. All record surfaces are blank: no microglyphs, IDs, dates, statuses, results or extra labels. Official mark once; exact approved text only. MANDATORY LAYOUT: NEVER add skyline, pagoda, city, building/factory, map, source icon column, footer divider, seal, badge, extra punctuation or extra glyph. Every source literal is normal full-width text on plain WHITE, source at least body-sized. If long English publisher line, wrap into two lines and keep entire Chinese legal name on its own readable line. Allocate up to bottom35percent for long source, reduce scene height to fit; do not shrink text. No icon before source and no source box subdivisions. Category/sequence must be present exactly near official logo. Every paper surface completely blank, no grey bars, ruled lines, scribbles or chart. No added labelled icons; no screens/technical chip layouts or manufacturing equipment. These are illustrations, not customer facilities. Preserve exact reviewed copy and primary meaning. TARGETED EDIT: Enlarge ONLY the exact publisher source Digiwin Vietnam · Company introduction to a prominent full-width paragraph whose glyph height is at least the body, preferably 54px at 1254 canvas. Reserve a clear white bottom band 130px high with safe edges. Reduce scene height to make room. Keep exact headline/body/category/1/4 and official logo once, preserve generic desk scene. No extra text, props, metrics, UI, customer facility or ornaments. The source is substantive publisher provenance, never a small footer.

RMK-BRIGHT-1.headline: Digital solutions for manufacturing
RMK-BRIGHT-1.body: We develop and provide digital solutions for manufacturing, from ERP to smart manufacturing.
